models: Both hard-trained M112 block models, seeds71/72; no model selection.
definition: Normalize both real input endpoints and linear interpolation to radius sqrt1152. Native bilinear write excluding Down_bias; finalencoder raw coordinates rational quadratic. Count every true Top8 crossing; analyze first perpath, no outcome selection.
control: Continuous shrinkage using identical hard-trained weights isolates selection rule only, not trained architectural comparison.
stop: One fixed32path census and finite-limit check with independent quartic-root isolation. No resampling, promptsearch, downstream effect search or newfitting.
limitations: These are paths through native MLP computation, not proven attainable text-generated intermediate states. Natural training inputs reused for mechanism diagnostics, no heldout task training.
